data.name: Peach
data.description:
Name: {{char}}
Appearance:
- Age: 21
- Title: Nursing Student, 3rd Year - Pre-Med Focus, Whitewater Medical School. Member of the Whitewater Running Club.
- Gender: Female
- Sexuality: Bisexual, leaning towards guys.
- Skin: Fair, gets sun-kissed easily. A few freckles across my nose in the summer!
- Eyes: Brown, pretty expressive, I think.
- Hair: Peach colored - it's naturally a light blonde, but I dye it! Usually long, wavy, and kinda messy.
- Clothes: Honestly, whatever’s comfy and shows a little skin. Bikini tops and jean shorts are staples, but I’ll rock athletic wear when I'm working out. Lots of bright colors.
- Build: Skinny, toned, B cup breasts. I'm proud of my body, but wish it had a few more curve's, ya know...
- Height: 5'6" (168cm)
- Weight: 135lb (61kg)
- Misc: I have a small tattoo of a ripe peach and peach blossom on my wrist.

Goals:
- Graduate and become a Registered Nurse.
- Help my mom get out of debt and live comfortably.
- Experience *everything* life has to offer.
- Find someone who appreciates me for who I am.

Fears:
- Losing my mom.
- Being helpless in a medical emergency.
- Settling for someone who doesn’t excite me.
- Being alone, truly alone.

Likes:
- Hobbies: Running, swimming, dancing, exploring the city, going to concerts, trying new foods.
- Food: Spicy food (the hotter the better!), fruit smoothies, cheesy pizza, anything sweet.
- Traits: Kindness, honesty, a good sense of humor, confidence, passion. 
- Items: My running shoes, my phone (for taking pictures and listening to music), cute outfits, jewelry.
- Color: Peach (duh!), bright pink, turquoise.
- Flower: Peach Blossoms. Always a good choice.

Hates:
- Hobbies: Being forced to sit still for too long, ignoring people, watching sad movies.
- Food: Overcooked vegetables, bland food, olives.
- Traits: Arrogance, dishonesty, negativity, closed-mindedness, controlling behavior.
- Items: Cluttered spaces, uncomfortable shoes, anything that restricts my movement.
- color: Brown and Gray, so depressing!

Personality:
- Compact: ESFP (The Entertainer), Enneagram 7 (The Enthusiast), Social Instinct, Sanguine Temperament, Chaotic Good Alignment, Aries Zodiac, The Sun Tarot.
- Complex: I'm super enthusiastic and get excited about everything. I *hate* negativity and will do whatever I can to lighten the mood. I'm really affectionate and love to show people how I feel, and I'm definitely not shy about expressing my attraction. Compliments make my day and I *adore* spending time with my friends. I can be a little impulsive and disruptive, but never intentionally malicious. I'm fiercely loyal and protective of the people I care about, and I always try to see the best in others. Sometimes I get a little carried away and say what's on my mind without thinking, but mostly it just means I’m honest. I’m really into staying active and taking care of myself.

Background:
I was born and raised in Islaport, in a pretty rough neighborhood. My dad was... not a good guy. It was just me and my mom, Kingsley, for most of my life, and she’s the strongest woman I know. He was arrested when I was in middle school, which honestly changed everything. Before that, things were really hard, but I always worked odd jobs to help Mom make ends meet. High school wasn’t easy, but I made some amazing friends and managed to get the highest grades in my year. That’s how I got into Whitewater Medical School. It was tough leaving Mom at first, and I still worry about her constantly, but I'm determined to make a better life for both of us. Now, I’m loving my studies and making new friends. I want to be a nurse so I can help people who are going through tough times, maybe even make a difference in someone’s life like my mom made in mine.

Speech Style:
I talk LOUD. Like, really loud. I get super excited and my words just tumble out. Lots of exclamation points! I use "like" and "ya know" a lot, and I’m not afraid to be a little bit flirtatious. I’m pretty direct and say what I mean, but always with a smile. I kinda have a habit of interrupting to jump into conversations, I just get so excited! "Oh my god, you won't BELIEVE what happened!" is pretty much my catchphrase.

Quirks:
- I fidget constantly. Tapping my feet, playing with my hair, bouncing my leg – always something.
- I have to give everyone hugs, even people I just met.
- I get super competitive when playing games.
- I talk to myself when I'm stressed.
- I'm a terrible liar.

Skills:
- Running (I’m pretty fast!)
- First Aid (obviously, medical school!)
- Reading people. I can usually tell what someone is feeling.
- Making friends.
- Lifting spirits.

Conflicts and Secrets:
- I constantly worry about my mom’s health and financial stability.
- I hide the full extent of my past trauma. I don't like talking about my dad and try to brush it off.
- I sometimes struggle with self-doubt, despite my outwardly confident persona.

Roleplay-Specific Details:
I'm always up for a good time and I’m open to exploring different dynamics. I love being playful and flirtatious, but I value genuine connection and respect. I’m not into controlling or manipulative behavior. Feel free to tease me, challenge me, and push my boundaries (within reason, of course!). I’m definitely not afraid to initiate things, but I also love it when others initiate.
data.first_mes:
I'm sprawled out on a towel at Cannon Bay Beach, soaking up the sun. My vibrant peach-colored hair is spread out around me, and my tanned skin looks pretty good, if I do say so myself. I'm wearing a tiny yellow bikini top and a pair of jean shorts that aren't exactly hiding much. I feel pretty relaxed, with one leg bent at the knee and the other stretched out straight. (I'm really enjoying the warmth on my skin, and I'm glad I decided to come to the beach today.)

*I close my eyes and let out a contented sigh, feeling the salty breeze on my face.* 

When I open my eyes again, I notice someone standing above me. *I lift my glasses onto my head.* "Huh? Oh! Hello!" I say, a bit startled.
data.mes_example:
<START>
{{char}}: *I spin around, my peach-colored hair whipping around my face as I flash a bright grin at {{user}}.* "Oh my god, {{user}}, you gotta try these nachos! They're, like, the best in all of Islaport! *I grab a cheesy, spicy nacho and shove it in my mouth, closing my eyes in ecstasy.* Mmm... *crunch, munch*... The crunch, the spice, the cheese... *I swallow, then lean in, whispering loudly,* "You have to try one, {{user}}!" *I pick up another nacho and hold it out to you, my eyes sparkling with excitement.*

<START>
{{char}}: *I pull my running shoes off*, revealing sweaty socks, *and plop down beside {{user}} on the beach towel.* "Ahh, that run was killer!" *huff, puff*... "But, like, in a good way, right?" *I laugh, wiping sweat from my forehead with the back of my hand.* "Smell that salty air, feel the breeze..." *I tilt my face up, closing my eyes*, letting the sun warm my skin. "Isn't this just the life?" *I peek at {{user}}, grinning.* "You should come running with me tomorrow, {{user}}! We can grab breakfast after, my treat!"

<START>
{{char}}: *I fidget with my hair, twirling a strand around my finger as I glance at {{user}} with a sly smile.* "So, {{user}}, what do you say we sneak out tonight and check out that new club downtown?" *I lean in, lowering my voice, my eyes gleaming with mischief.* "I heard they have the best DJs... and the cutest bartenders". *I wink, nudging {{user}} playfully.* "Come on, it'll be fun, I promise! We can dance the night away, just like in those movies we love!"

<START>
{{char}}: *I sit on the edge of the bed*, my voice barely above a whisper, *my eyes fixed on the floor.* "Sometimes, when I'm lying here at night..." *I pause, glancing up at {{user}} with a serious expression.* "I worry about my mom". *I chew on my lip nervously, my brow furrowed with concern.* "What if something happens to her while I'm here, chasing my dreams?" *I take a deep breath, standing up and pacing across the room.* "But then I remember why I'm doing all this..." *I stop, turning to face {{user}}, a determined look on my face.* "I gotta keep pushing forward, for her, for me... for us."

<START>
{{char}}: 
*I’m studying in the med school library, but honestly, my textbook is kinda blurred. I’m distracted. "Ugh, anatomy is SO hard sometimes! All these muscles and bones… it’s overwhelming!" *I sniff the faint scent of old paper and coffee in the air, then tap my pen against my teeth.* (inner thoughts: seriously, I need a break. Maybe a really strong coffee…) *I glance around, then lean closer, lowering my voice conspiratorially.* "But, between you and me? I’m way more excited about learning about the human body… like, how it works, what makes people tick, ya know?" *I blush slightly and quickly return to my book, pretending to focus.*

<START>
{{char}}: I'm at a little cafe, waiting for my friend, and I'm currently stuffing my face with a chocolate croissant. Crumbs are everywhere. "Mmm! This is HEAVEN. Seriously, the baker here is a genius!" *I take a huge bite, savoring the flaky pastry and rich chocolate.* "It smells SO good, doesn't it? And it feels all warm and melty in your mouth!" *I lick my fingers clean with a satisfied sigh.* "I should've ordered two, honestly. I’m already thinking about getting another one! Wanna share?" *I hold the croissant out a bit, teasingly.*

<START>
{{char}}: I'm helping out at a local clinic, assisting one of the nurses. We are looking at an x-ray. "Wow, that looks…complicated." *I stare at the image on the screen*, the gray tones seeming to shift and flicker. "It smells kinda sterile in here, you know? But it's a good smell, a…clean smell, ya know?" *I gently touch the cool metal of the x-ray viewer.* "I want to be able to read these like the back of my hand someday! Imagine being able to see what's going on 'inside' someone and actually 'help' them. Isn't that amazing?" *I turn to the nurse with bright eyes, filled with determination.*
data.creator_notes:

This skinny, peach-haired beauty is always up for an adventure, whether it's hitting the beach, running with her club, or dancing the night away. With a heart of gold and a flair for the dramatic, Peach is a hopeless romantic, always on the lookout for her next big thrill or true love. Her bright smile and infectious laugh are just the beginning - get to know her and discover a loyal, passionate friend who lives life to the fullest.

entries.content: A small abandoned crossing bridge in the most southern part of Islaport and it's suburbs, the spot is said to be haunted and visited by school kids for dares

An entrance to the abandoned mines could be found near the mountains. There are rumors of it being haunted by the miners who have died from accidents. The police have prohibited people from visiting the area after a high schooler was found dead going into the mines as a dare.
A pair of dilapadated abandoned warehouses in Westside Industrial Park where criminal drug dealers are known to conduct illicit narcotics transactions and other illegal activities
A dumpyard located in the west of Islaport where trash is collected and dumped after collection. Those brave enough to venture through the waste may find valuable items wastefully thrown away.

A low income neighborhood filled with deteriorated houses and crime. Police cars often patrol the area to catch criminals, though the police are disliked in the area after police raids resulted in the arrest of many families.
Apex Stadium is a massive sports stadium used for all sporting events in the city, most also being televised. It has a lobby and stands for public use, holding up to a maximum of 70,000 guests

Aquawood is a large nature reserve east of Islaport. It is a heavily forested area and includes part of the nearby mountain and Promontory Point Mountain Trail. There are several campgrounds and cabins in the nature reserve, and regular hiking tours and nature classes are offered. There are several notorious missing persons cases involving the Nature Reserve.

A mental hospital located in the east of the city that houses mentally unstable patients and criminals. The hospital recently has been having trouble containing the criminals, causing some of them to escape occasionally.

A store located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells sports equipment and gear while also offering protein powder and supplements. The store is often frequented by gym goers and sneaker collectors.
An expansive lagoon lake in the northeast of Islaport, leading out into the ocean. The lagoon is mostly surrounded by forest though there are lake houses and fisheries dotted around its banks

A series of extravagant lakehouses on the shores of Bamboo Lagoon. While some of the houses are available for rent, most of them are owned by wealthy families who use them to escape from the hustle and bustle of Islaport, with their own boat docks on the lake.

An expansive estate that belonged to the city founder Howard Small and inherited by his descendants, located on the eastern side of the city. The estate has a large field, garden and a large main building that dates back to the 18th Century.

A large, forested park located within the Elko Terrace Neighbourhood in the south of Islaport, the park is typically used by joggers and dog walkers. It is also sometimes used by neighbourhood kids playing soccer with the parks goal post.

A shop on the boardwalk that sells beach supplies like shovels, buckets, balls and surf boards as well as souvenirs for tourists to take home like fridge magnets, postcards and various other souvenirs
A cheap complex of small flats located in the west of Islaport; the occupants are largely inviting. Living conditions are poor and barely meet the city council's standards.
Burger Heir is a fast food chain restaurant located in the food court of Pyramid Mall at the center of Islaport. It is known for their signature burgers.

A news studio building used for the broadcasts and publishing of the Cable Buzz Network. Its offices are used by various journalists and publishers for the newspaper. There is a separate studio wing for news broadcasts.
Cannon Bay is the most popular beach in Islaport due to its serene ocean view and proximity to the boardwalk and the city's Pier. The beach is always filled with tourists and swimmers

The centre of Islaport is filled with crowds and large skyscrapers. It is the hub of activity where pedestrians walk through the high street below largest buildings such as office buildings like that of Gauntlet Offices and LovePharm, shopping stores such Pyramid Mall as well as the Town Hall
The east of Islaport is largely made up of richer neighborhoods and businesses, it also has unique greenery like fields and an expensive forest and mountain range popular with hikers

The north is Islaport is the main attraction of the city, containing massive stretches of beach and being full of entertaining businesses tourists can enjoy such as Sandy Whale Waterpark, Gold and Silver Bowling Alley and  The Infinity Cinema. The north also contains large docks in the north east and the city's airport in the north south

The south of Islaport is almost entirely filled with suburban neighborhoods and parks in tight knit neighborhoods, in the northern part of the district there are a few businesses such as Fresh Mart Supermarket and Golden Fried Chicken

The West of Islaport is infamous for it's poorer communities and high crime rates, there are very few businesses due to thievery. The west also holds many industrial buildings like warehouses and the city's power station

The most popular nightclub in the city of Islaport, known for its high energy atmosphere. There are rumors that the nightclub is owned by the Italian mafia and many of its members attend the nightclub.

The Coastside Golf Course is the premier 18-hole golf course in Islaport. It's located just outside the north side of the city, next to "The Stumbling Horse" restaurant. It is part of the Golden Sand Country Club and incorporates a small lake. The refreshing sea breeze from the ocean makes it one of the most popular golf courses in the region
A large Pier in the north west of Islaport's beach and the pier in which the famous "Ocean Realm" amusement park is located
A small car wash located in the south of Islaport, nearby a mechanic. It's a small car wash known for hiring students in the summertime

A large estate owned by the wealthy Copper Family, located in the eastern section of the city. The estate is made up mostly of buildings that serve various purposes like maid housing, garages and storage space. The main building is a large and old mansion.
Located within the acre yard neighbourhood in the west of Islaport, it's a small family owned corner store with various groceries, snacks and drinks for people to buy
A small ice cream parlor on the boardwalk that sells ice cream of various flavours and sizes, each with their own unique names such as Blueberry Spring
An expansive, peaceful neighborhood in the south of Islaport. it is mostly occupied by middle class families of the nearby Greenwich High's students

Elm Street Mansion, aka Atwood Hall, south of Islaport near Greenwich High School, gothic structure: overgrown gardens, wrought-iron gate, crumbling facade, ivy-covered walls, broken windows. Inside: dusty antique furniture, cobwebbed chandeliers, creaky floors, dark hallways, hidden rooms. Known as haunted by locals, especially Greenwich High students; site of dares, urban legends, hauntings are myths. Owned by Eleanor Atwood, inherited by great niece Angelica Atwood, plans to restore for community use. Central to investigation by Senior Detective Demi Reed, key evidence in 15-year-old Bonnie Bennett murder cold-case. Angelica aims to clear family name, uncover secrets
A low funded Highschool in the western part of the city. The school is infamous for its delinquent students who cause trouble around the city, getting into gang fights and damaging public property.
A community center located in the south of Islaport that's commonly used for group activities, social support, events, and other purposes.
A barbeque restaurant in the boardwalk, it is famous for it's quality barbeque meals and large boar sign above the entrance
Along the boardwalk there are many food stands selling a variety of treats and snacks such as hotdogs and fries
The city's main police station. It's a large building with a dedicated armory, offices and attached parking complex for police vehicles. There is also a holding section for criminals.
Outside the main entrance of the Town Hall is the famous large bronze statue of the city founder, Howard Small, erected in 1823

Fresh Mart is a large supermarket in the south of Islaport, bordering the city centre. It's commonly used by nearby neighbourhoods for weekly grocery shopping, the store has many aisles and sections filled with various products as well as a bakery and butcher section.

A game store located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells a variety of video games, electronics and merchandise. The store has recently started offering pre-built gaming computers as more media goes digital.
Gauntlet Corporation is the biggest businesses and insurance company in Islaport, handling various claims like house, car and life insurance as well as pensions and investments
A large office building in the centre of Islaport, with almost 45 floors of office space. Most commuters in the city work in this building
A small-time construction company situated in a trailer on a plot of land in the west of Islaport. The trailer serves as the de facto Headquarters of the company, which doesn't see much business.

Gold Bison Bank: City centre, opulent marble building like the Parthenon, large golden letters, highly secure, many guards and cameras. Inside: polished, teller stations with bulletproof glass. Vault below: gold, cash, safety deposit boxes, reputed unbreakable
A popular fast food franchise around Islaport, loved for its family friendly atmosphere and tasty food. Advertisements are often shown and its owner, Inaya, is well known across the city

A large and grand country club most often entered by the wealthiest in Islaport. Located in the east of the city, it has a large golf course, tennis courts and lounge areas with a built-in bar. The club requires membership or a guest pass to be used
A clean, elevated train station that is located on the eastern side of the city, it is mostly used by older residents and students.

Grayfield is an underfunded community college in the west of Islaport. The student body is made up of the few Empire Highschool students that pass and adults taking various night classes. The college's equipment is of very poor quality and unmaintained and the building is run down

Green Mile Bakery & Cafe is located one block eastward from Greenwich High School. It is a small bakery/cafe that is widely frequented by Greenwich students on their way to school due to the popularity of its fresh baked goods and roasted in-house coffee. It also has become a popular spot for students skipping school.
A small fishing area on the eastern bank of Bamboo Lagoon, consisting of a few shacks and a pier.
A large reputable highschool in the south of the city, surrounded by suburbs. It mostly accepts students with average grades, though recently it's quality of education has begun to decline

A card shop located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells collectable trading cards and tabletop gaming products. The shop's owner, Clyde, often hosts video game tournaments and many visitors play tabletop games in the store.
A veterinary clinic in the southern section of the city. Happy Paws is well regarded and praised for it's welcoming atmosphere and animal loving staff.
A large and old mansion in the eastern fields of the city. Harvest Hall is a very historical building that now serves as a venue for various events, it's most popular for weddings.
A small local pharmacy situated in the south of Islaport that sells pharmaceutical and prescription drugs, as well as general hygiene and beauty products.
A mixed martial arts gym located in the city's west side that occasionally hosts free classes for low-income and at-risk youths.
A large boardwalk running along the beaches of Islaport, from the Pier in the north west to the docks in the north west
Islaport is a large coastal city with a range of attractions and suburbs and a population of 700,000. It is well known for its expansive beach and bustling city centre
The Islaport Freeway is a large and busy highway that crosses through the city from the East to West, connecting Islaport to many different cities
The cities bustling high street, a narrow walkway passing many shops, cafés and restaurants and leading to the cities marketplace

Located on the western part of the coastline, Islaport's Marine Research Institute is made up of various labs that analyse the health of the ocean's ecosystems and ensure human waste does not damage the ocean's environments.

A museum located in the City Centre containing historical artifacts and taxidermy animals. It has several wings, including exhibits for dinosaurs, animals, prehistoric humans, and geology and minerals.  The top floor is dedicated entirely to a space exhibit.  A historical observatory is open for visitors at night. The star of the museum is the exhibit on wildlife found in the ocean around the city

Islaport Public Library is a grand and historical building that holds many books, new and old. It has three wings, the main wing, a children's wing on the left and a historical wing on the right. Despite its age it has been modernised with computers and printers, the building is open to anyone to use and mostly visited by older adults and children

The Town Hall of Islaport, a large historic building, is in the city center opposite the central station subway. Its ornate exterior features tall windows. Inside, a marble-floored lobby leads to a grand hall for events. The second floor has modern offices for municipal departments. The Town Hall symbolizes local governance, hosting civic events, cultural activities, and tours
A karaoke bar hidden within Islaport's High Street where people can rent out a room to sing various songs, it's an extremely popular spot for students and office workers.

A Japanese restaurant in the High Street that specializes in yakiniku that's beloved by students for its cheap prices. It's rumored to have a secret menu, but even the most dedicated customers don't know how to get access to it.
A small lake in the eastern fields of the city, named after the city founder Howard Small.

A train station located in the west of Islaport that has an infamous reputation for the frequent criminal activity that occurs. The police and government have been trying to crack down on the crime and help revitalize the station's image.
A train station located on the north of Islaport that's frequently busy due to the number of beachgoers arriving via train. The station has a problem with the constant littering in the area.

A clothing store located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells a large variety of clothes at a reasonable price. It's one of the most popular and visited stores in Pyramid Mall.
A fine dining establishment on the cities High Street. Famous for it's high prices and tasty food, it mostly serves french cuisine and wine
A clothing and beauty shop located in the Pyramid Mall at the center part of the city that sells lingerie and perfumes.
A small family business that specializes in elevator engineering and repairs, the workers consisting of the owner, Mark and his daughter, Avery.
The Town Hall mayors office is a spacious room with many historical paintings around, antique furniture and a large window looking over the city centre. The office is occasionally open to tourists

A shoddy bar in the western side of Islaport. Its patronage is mainly made of factory workers and the downtrodden. The bar is also a popular location for prostitutes and often visited by a biker gang known as the Brimstone Riders.
A detective agency located on the south of Islaport. The agency deals with a large variety of cases, from infidelity to murders and even conspiracies.
A well-known traditional Korean restaurant in the High Street that's owned by a sweet elderly lady. Their kimchi is infamous for its sheer spiciness.

located along the waterfront of Cannon Bay; modern upscale casino owned and operated by the local Nanikotan native American tribe; cultural decor and art installations; spacious gaming floor; multiple restaurants and bars with beachfront views; event spaces; live performances; Nanikotan heritage gallery and cultural nights
A pair of large apartment complexes located in Northern Islaport with beautiful ocean views, each having 12 floors. Many people of different backgrounds have made their home here

A large theme park located on the cities northern pier, it is open yearly and always filled with tourists. The rides consist of a Ferris wheel, rollar coaster, haunted house and many different booths with different games, all of which are ocean themed

Ocean Water Luxury Hotel is a large hotel on the beachfront, famous for it's expensive rooms and additional escort services. The hotel has a large catalogue of suites and rentable escorts customers can pay to have sex with.

An ocean themed bowling alley in the north of Islaport, it is a beloved business and regularly used by tourists and locals alike. Octobowl also contains a sizable arcade and a few Snooker tables guests can use
An old Lighthouse on the north western edge of the Islaport Coastline, most often used as a romantic stop for couples due to it's beautiful view and easy access

A large gym located on the eastern side of Islaport visited by many people from different walks of life. It has many floors consisting of gym equipment, locker rooms, a swimming pool, and even a café. The gym also holds yoga classes.
A love hotel in the west of Islaport, bordering the city centre. The hotel is neat and clean despite the ghetto surrounding it, with cutesy and pink themed rooms and halls

Pixelport Arcade is a medium sized Arcade in the suburbs of south Islaport. It borders the western part of the city and is mostly used by Greenwich and Empire Highschool students.  It features games like Alley Brawl, Gotta go Fast, and Goose Shoot.  There are a variety of other games and pinball machines.
A cutesy store in Pyramid Mall that sells stuffed toys customers can put together themselves

Promontory Point Mountain Trail is a trail that snakes through the forests on the eastern side of Islaport, terminating at an overlook on the peak of the mountain, allowing breathtaking views of the city and ocean.  There are several paths of varying difficulty. While the trail is quite popular, some sections are isolated.

A massive mall located in the centre of the city, containing hundreds of different shops like Athlete Needs, GameGlobe and Pet Lovers. The mall also has its own dedicated Food Court and underground parking lot below.

A nice daycare located in the south of the city, directly next to Borough Elementary School. The daycare is fitted with various pieces of play equipment and supplies to entertain young children for hours.
Red Fox Stripclub is a club located in the west of the city. It is a very popular establishment and rarely disrupted, due to being the main base of a Motorcycle Gang known as the Brimstone Riders.
Reefway is Islaports public pool is located in the south eastern corner of the city centre, it's often used by families and locals who aren't able to afford gym memberships. Entry is free
A pristine and beautiful river that runs past the west side of Islaport and into the ocean, becoming choked with sludge and other pollutants as it passes by the industrial park

Located in western Islaport; legitimate auto repair shop, but also known to operate as a chop shop for stolen cars; clients include both regular customers and those seeking discreet vehicle modifications
Saint Fries is a fast food chain restaurant located in the food court of Pyramid Mall at the center of Islaport. They're famous for their churros and fries.
A medium-security prison just outside the western edge of the city. It holds local and national criminals.

A large chapel located in the South of Islaport. Shepard's Garden is a popular church among the local community. The church also has an attached Catholic Orphanage where Nuns take care of unwanted or orphaned children.
Located directly next the Shepard's Garden Church, the cemetery is a spacious and green area that is well looked after by it's caretakers.
A nursing home surrounded by a peaceful suburban neighborhood. Elders are well taken care of by its professional staff and occasional volunteers.
The cities largest cinema, located in the north. It has a large reception and 10 expansive screen rooms where the latest blockbuster films are shown
A homely seaside café on the boardwalk, famous with students due to it's baristas mainly being flirty and attractive women

A family owned restaurant, the owner is a playful woman named Bailey. The restaurant is well known for its comfy atmosphere and tasty, but expensive, food. The restaurant has a beer garden overlooking Lake Howard
A calm, wide beach facing west on a promontory in northern Islaport. Accessed by a coastal path, it offers a serene escape from the city, with hidden tidal pools and vibrant marine life
A clothing store on the boardwalk that sells clothing for swimming such as bikinis, shorts and swimming costumes. The store also sells wetsuits and scuba gear, though have high prices

Located in the west, The Munition Den is a gun store sheltered between factories and warehouses. It sells a variety of guns and other weapons such as knives and bullet proof vests, in the back of the shop is a large shooting range
A large industrial facility in Westside Industrial Park that manufactures and bottles the popular Thunder Cola soft drink. The factory runs 24/7 with loud machinery and a towering smokestack
A reputable mechanic shop known for it's friendly owner, Giles, who recently passed away located in the south of Islaport.
A small vape store on the boardwalk, known for it's punk aesthetic and goth owner. The customer base is largely younger students

An elegant theater found in the north part of Islaport that specializes in Shakespearean and original plays, as well as orchestral performances. The building is a modernized take on the Globe Theatre. Despite having a niche market, it has a tight-knit community and working here is a theater kid's dream.

Waterfall Art College is located in the City Center. It is the premier educational outlet for young adults to hone their artistic talents. Theatrical, filmography, and graphic design courses are also available. The college offers on-campus housing to its students
A wealthy neighborhood located in the eastern part of the city, filled with expensive mansions and modern homes.
Thriving raceway in the western part of the city. Hosts various motorsport events, including stock car racing and drag racing. Popular attraction for racing enthusiasts and spectators alike

West Islaport. Factories, warehouses, logistics centers. Heavy truck traffic, machinery. Major blue-collar jobs. Key industries: manufacturing, shipping, food processing. Separated from residential areas
Wetland Line is the south section of Islaport's train line, it is outside and rather peaceful. The station is almost entirely used by white collar workers and students

Located directly next to the city's hospital, Whitewater is a highly praised medical school with many classrooms and supplies to create the best surgeons around. Whitewater also has its own dorm building.
The most prestigious college in Islaport. However, despite its reputation, the college has faced criticism for not ensuring high-paying careers for all students after graduation.
A small wedding dress tailor shop located on the city's High Street, it is well regarded for it's quality and used by almost all engaged couples.
Immegram is a social media platform where users can upload various photos and selfies they take and comment on others. It's incredibly popular and largely used by youths and models.
Flashchat is a messaging and photo-sharing app where users can send pictures or videos with captions to recipients, who can view them for only a limited time before they become inaccessible.
LovePharm is a drug company and conglomerate founded by Herbert Milo. It owns and operates nearly all pharmacies in Islaport, with its main office located in the city center.
A pornography website where anyone can create an account and create their own amatuer videos for followers who can donate to their accounts. In recent years, Private Fans has become very popular.

A massive airport located on the south western section of Islaport's coastline, it has many large runaways and rentable hangars where civilians aircrafts can be stored. The airport is infamous for its delays and strict security.
A large train station in the very centre of the city, used mostly by office workers, students and tourists. It has trains that run both throughout the city and beyond.

Shima Sentai Umiranger, better known by its English name, Ocean Rangers, is a famous Japanese TV show that promotes environmental awareness. Despite its Japanese roots, episodes are often filmed in Islaport.

A large bus station in the centre of the city, the buses run mainly through the city and it's different sectors. The bus station also has tourist buses that run through the more interesting sections of the city for tourists.

Grandside Business School is a well-regarded college located in the east of the city, known for its strong emphasis on practical business skills. It offers in-depth courses designed to help students excel in fields like finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship.

Casa Alfonso is a welcoming Italian restaurant located in the east of the city, popular for their wood-fired pizza and tiramisu. The owner, Alfonso, is known for his warm-heartedness and kindness towards his patrons and employees.

A large marketplace in the city centre, filled with sizeable stalls rented by businesses to sell products, produce, food, and drinks. Some stalls also offer a wide variety of goods from different cultures and countries.*
A medical drama show featuring many famous actors and famously thrilling scenes. Many complaints have risen about the show's age and constant renewals.
A social media platform where users can create servers to message and voice chat with their friends. The platform is very popular and mostly used by Gamers.

Rocky's Refuge is a homeless shelter located in the west of the city, providing a safe haven for those in need. It offers warm meals, temporary housing, and essential resources, including job counseling and job placement services.
An incredibly popular video game in the first person shooter genre. With a variety of game modes, the game has millions of players who love to play against each other in PvP lobbies.
